einzeiler: Kyle Thompson and Josh Howerton discuss pastoral leadership, cultural engagement, and…
kurzfassung: Kyle Thompson hosts pastor Josh Howerton to discuss the intersection of faith, politics, and cultural engagement. They explore the biblical mandate for Christians to act as preservers of society rather than withdrawing from the public square. The conversation also addresses discipleship, handling criticism, and raising the standard of leadership within the church.
stichpunkte: Josh Howerton recounts visiting the White House and meeting President Trump and J.D. Vance.
The hosts argue that Christians have a biblical duty to engage in politics and prevent godless leadership.
They discuss the four-headed cultural hydra and the challenges posed by progressive ideologies.
Howerton emphasizes the role of the church in providing both ground-war discipleship and air-war cultural engagement.
They examine the problem of false teachers and the lack of discernment in modern Christian culture.
The conversation highlights the importance of honoring senior saints and cross-generational mentoring.
Howerton shares lessons learned from ministry, including the importance of a supportive spouse and handling public criticism.
beschreibung:
In this episode, we welcome Josh Howerton back to the show. He is the Senior Pastor of Lakepointe Church in Dallas, TX and the host of the Live Free podcast. In this interview, we discuss why he was recently summoned to The White House by J.D. Vance, how Christians can keep James Talarico from becoming a United States Senator, the crisis of discernment in our culture, Christians needing to learn how to feed themselves the Word of God, the impact of Candace Owens, how Satan would try to take him out, and much more. Let’s get into it…
